entries.heading: Find your windows at a glance

entries.heading: Control music without switching windows
entries.setup: Needs a compatible player exposing MPRIS, such as Spotify. Start the player to see controls.

entries.heading: Take a small radio trip

entries.heading: Learn shortcuts while you use them
entries.setup: Requires Hyprland 0.55+ and the documented setup hook; installing the plugin alone is not the final step.

entries.heading: Make room for a focused work session
entries.setup: A Pomodoro timer with work and break periods. Review its timer settings after enabling.

entries.heading: Find your way between workspaces
entries.setup: Fictional demo: choose the workspaces to show in the map.
